defaults.prerequisites: Build the exact matching core, CLI, and optional MCP workspace packages and inspect the canonical local/skills tree.
defaults.action: Run the skill artifact and preflight integration tests against a disposable local project.

rows.requirement: Issue #160: canonical setup, authoring, and critique skills use the strict common Agent Skills profile
rows.oracle: Each directory/name matches and SKILL.md contains only name, description, license, compatibility, and inert string metadata with exact 1.0.0-beta.1 release identity.

rows.requirement: Issue #160: every independently copied skill includes complete legal material
rows.oracle: Each canonical directory includes a complete Apache-2.0 LICENSE, artifact NOTICE, and artifact-specific THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

rows.requirement: Issue #160: only setup contains a script and full preflight verifies the complete guided installation
rows.oracle: Full preflight detects payload tampering and verifies exact skill/CLI/MCP SemVer, Node 24, automation schema, host capability, local filesystem, and a validator-accepted disposable fixture that leaves no project entry.

rows.requirement: Issue #160: setup preserves approval and evidence boundaries
rows.oracle: Setup asks before every installation, configuration, or probe mutation; full preflight labels a host Supported only on an exact retained passing evidence row, otherwise passing capabilities report Compatible, mixed releases report repair_required without a host classification, and mandatory capability failure reports Unsupported.

rows.requirement: Issue #160: authoring uses a research-backed minimum-sufficient DAG and confirmation gate
rows.oracle: Authoring discovers project facts, starts from Terminal Results, splits only at meaningful Result handoffs, preserves independent branches, shows the complete proposal or diff, and writes only confirmed Workflow Definition content.

rows.requirement: Issue #160: authoring delegates correctness and creates no execution artifacts
rows.oracle: All three bundled examples pass the exact CLI validator; authoring routes deterministic meaning to the core and forbids Runs, outputs, Results, and StepArtifacts.

rows.requirement: Issue #160: critique validates first and remains read-only
rows.oracle: Critique stops on ordered deterministic diagnostics and, only when valid, covers Terminal Results, cohesion, handoffs, dependencies, parallelism, synthesis/revision, duplication/context, evidence/uncertainty/completion, Data Contracts, and authority confusion without writing.

rows.requirement: Issue #160: non-setup skills reject mixed release sets before main work
rows.oracle: Fast preflight checks the activating skill release, Node 24, exact CLI version, automation schema, explicit root, and optional MCP version without mutating the selected project.
